title: feat: document deliverables (PPT/Word/Excel build route) + interactive spreadsheet viewer
body:
## Summary

Implements roadmap items 01 (document deliverables) + 12 (interactive spreadsheet viewer) from the UX gap roadmap. Rebased onto current main (post #599/#603/#604).

## Document deliverables (#01)

- Contracts: `DeckSpec` / `DocSpec` / `WorkbookSpec` (specVersion 1) with bounded parsing (slide/block/sheet caps) and versioned builders, so old artifacts are never re-rendered.
- Daemon builders: pptxgenjs (deck layouts incl. two-column + speaker notes), docx (headings/paragraphs/bullets/tables), exceljs (named sheets, CJK names supported) writing real office files into the workspace `.ling-stack/deliverables/` directory via `POST /deliverables/build`.
- Run-artifact registration happens when the harness tool lands (follow-up slice); the route is the substrate.

## Spreadsheet viewer (#12)

- Sync sheet-name extraction from the workbook zip (`fflate`) for the preview envelope — a preview never pays for a full ExcelJS parse.
- Workspace-bound windowed route `GET /previews/spreadsheet` (path traversal rejected with 403); formulas are served for reference and **never evaluated**.
- Web `SpreadsheetGrid`: sheet tabs, sticky headers, cell selection with coordinate + formula bar, load-more windowing so a 500k-row sheet never loads whole.

## Test evidence

- Daemon unit suites: builder round-trips (pptx zip structure + speaker notes slide XML, docx document.xml content incl. CJK, xlsx re-read via exceljs with CJK sheet names), spec validation, window clamping, extraction windows, API routes — 14 tests green on rebased main.
- Playwright spec with screenshot evidence (`output/playwright/spreadsheet-viewer/`): sheet tab switching, cell selection, formula display; adjacent preview suites (local-file, artifact-preview, gen-ui) pass with no regressions.
- Web typecheck + i18n check green (en-US/zh-CN catalogs updated).

title: Discover shared .agents skills with explicit publication
body:
## Summary
- Auto-discover project and user `.agents/skills` as review-only candidates; block unsafe/duplicate sources and isolate publication ownership.
- Add visible scan, ignored/orphaned controls, reference metadata and explicit new-skill confirmation.
- Document Design A and its implementation; separate local macOS packaging observations from strict formal release review.

## Validation
- Shared core/daemon/web model tests: 33 passed; desktop source projection: 118 passed; native publication/hooks: 154 passed.
- Web typecheck, lint, i18n, browser E2E: 1 passed; screenshot captured.
- Local macOS arm64 DMG and ZIP built; ZIP integrity, mounted DMG signature, app process launch and bundled Office resource checked.

Local installer evidence is marked release-ineligible; formal release validation remains separately gated.
